svg.title: Workflow automation platform — system architecture
svg.desc: Four-layer diagram: triggers (webhook, cron, manual) feed into a queue layer (API server and SQS), which drives an execution worker containing a DAG resolver, node runner, and context manager, all backed by a storage layer of MongoDB, execution logs, and a context cache.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain how webhook triggers work in this workflow platform — registration, validation, and enqueueing')
sendPrompt('How does the cron poller work with EventBridge — scanning workflows and avoiding duplicate runs?')
sendPrompt('How does the manual trigger work — what happens from UI button click to workflow starting?')
sendPrompt('What does the API server handle in this workflow platform architecture?')
sendPrompt('How is SQS used for workflow job queueing — message format, visibility timeout, and DLQ?')
sendPrompt('How does the DAG resolver work — topological sort, parallel vs sequential, conditional branching?')
sendPrompt('How does the node runner execute workflow nodes — input mapping, adapter pattern, retries?')
sendPrompt('How does the context manager store node outputs and resolve expressions like {{node.output.field}}?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in MongoDB for the workflow platform — schema design for workflows and executions?')
sendPrompt('What execution data is stored — schema for execution logs, node results, status tracking?')
sendPrompt('How is execution context cached between nodes — in-memory vs persistent, structure of the context object?')
